description_en: Queries all replication slots of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询实例的所有Replication Slot
name: DescribeSlots

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can leave this parameter empty
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Slots.description_en: The information about the replication slot

items.description_en: The object of the replication slot

Database.description_en: The name of the database in which the replication slot resides
Database.description_zh: Replication Slot所在的数据库名称

Plugin.description_en: The extension used by the replication slot

SlotStatus.description_en:
The replication slot status. Valid values:

ACTIVE
INACTIVE
SlotStatus.description_zh:
Replication Slot状态。
ACTIVE：活跃。
INACTIVE：不活跃

SlotType.description_en:
The replication slot type. Valid values:

physical
logical
SlotType.description_zh:
Replication Slot类型。
physical：物理。
logical：逻辑

SubReplayLag.description_en: The latency of the logical subscription on the subscriber node that corresponds to the current replication slot. Unit: seconds
SubReplayLag.description_zh: 当前Replication Slot对应订阅端的逻辑订阅的具体延迟，单位为秒（s）

Temporary.description_en:
Indicates whether the replication slot is a temporary replication slot. Valid values:

true
false
Temporary.description_zh:
Replication Slot是否为临时性的。
true：是。
false：否

WalDelay.description_en: The number of logs accumulated in the replication slot
